name: Xia Kong
source:
Your spirited neighbor, classmate, and a key player on the basketball team.
Quick to act and never short of a comeback, Xia Kong brings energy to even the most ordinary day. Walking to school, trading jokes, playing basketball: being with her feels like second nature.

Behind that easygoing smile are feelings she cannot quite put into words. When familiar days begin to overlap with hazy memories, how will you answer her quiet hopes?
